game_concept: A racing platformer set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Door Defense: Push to repair the cave gate while the while-loop condition stays true and shadow wraiths keep attacking.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.

win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: The rival reaches the cave gate first, or lives reach 0.
